title: UserInputService
summary: Client-only input hub: keyboard, mouse, touch, and gamepad events (InputBegan/Changed/Ended), plus device capability checks like TouchEnabled and GetMouseLocation.

events.name: InputBegan
events.description: Fires when any input starts (key press, touch, button). gameProcessed=true means the engine already used it (e.g. chat box open, controls).

events.name: InputChanged
events.description: Fires while input continues/moves (mouse movement, thumbstick).

methods.name: GetMouseLocation
methods.description: Current mouse position in screen pixels (client).

methods.name: IsKeyDown
methods.description: Poll whether a key is currently held.

explanation.whatItIs: The raw feed of everything the player physically does: presses, clicks, taps, stick tilts. Client-side only, because input happens on the player's machine.
explanation.whyItExists: Gameplay starts with input. UIS gives one event-driven API across every device type.
whenToUse: Mouse position for custom crosshairs or drag logic
Combining with ContextActionService for cross-device bindings
whenNotToUse: Server-side — input only exists on clients; send intents via remotes
When you want automatic touch buttons for mobile — that's ContextActionService's job
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
InputBegan fires for EVERY input:
  input.KeyCode   → which key/button (Enum.KeyCode.W)
  input.UserInputType → what kind (Keyboard / MouseButton1 / Touch)
  gameProcessed   → did Roblox already consume it?

if gameProcessed then return end   ← standard first line
```
tips: Always check `gameProcessed` before acting, or your keybind fires while typing in chat
Track held state with InputBegan/InputEnded pairs, or poll IsKeyDown in a loop
For gameplay actions supporting mobile + gamepad, prefer ContextActionService
commonMistakes: Ignoring gameProcessed → abilities trigger while typing in chat
Using UIS in a Script (server) — it's client-only
Binding to Enum.KeyCode.LeftMouseButton instead of checking UserInputType.MouseButton1

examples.title: Keybind with gameProcessed guard
examples.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if gameProcessed then return end   -- chat/controls already used it

    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
        print("E pressed — interact!")
    elseif input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        print("Left click!")
    end
end)

examples.title: Device-aware UI
examples.code:
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

if UserInputService.TouchEnabled then
    print("Mobile layout: show big touch buttons")
else
    print("Desktop layout: show keybind hints")
end
